episode.judul: Ken Arok: Takdir dari Tumapel — Prototype 30s
episode.style: cinematic realistic, Javanese period drama, dark-fantasy tones
episode.catatan: Prototype 30 detik untuk validasi end-to-end pipeline (T2I → I2V → TTS → stitch). 6 segmen × 5 detik. Babak pembuka — Ken Arok menemui takdirnya.

characters.peran: Protagonis — pemuda pencuri yang ditakdirkan jadi raja
characters.physical_characteristics: Pria Jawa 25 tahun, tubuh atletis tangguh, kulit cokelat keemasan, rahang tegas, mata cokelat amber melirik predator, rambut hitam ikal panjang berantakan
characters.clothing_accessories: Ikat kepala kain crimson lusuh, rompi cokelat tanpa lengan di atas dada telanjang, sarung batik indigo di atas lutut diikat tali hemp, gelang tali dipergelangan tangan, kaki telanjang berlumpur
characters.backstory: Yatim piatu yang dibesarkan jadi pencuri dan bandit di hutan Tumapel. Bertemu Dang Hyang Lohgawe yang meramalkan dia sebagai penjelmaan Wisnu yang ditakdirkan jadi raja

characters.physical_characteristics: Pria Asia Tenggara 60-an, tubuh kurus berotot, kulit sawo matang terpanggang matahari, tulang pipi menonjol, mata cokelat gelap menembus, rambut besi panjang diikat topknot, jenggot putih sepanjang kerah
characters.clothing_accessories: Jubah katun putih lusuh melilit bahu kiri (gaya Brahmana), dhoti sebatas betis, kalung tasbih rudraksha cokelat, sandal jangkar kulit tua
characters.backstory: Resi Hindu dari India yang mengembara ke Jawa mencari raja yang ditakdirkan. Melihat Ken Arok bukan pencuri rendahan, tapi avatar Wisnu

locations.physical_characteristics: Hutan jati tropis luas dengan pohon-pohon tinggi berkulit kering, semak berduri lebat, batang pohon tumbang berlumut di jalur tanah kering. Bebatuan kapur berserakan. God rays menembus kanopi
Interior pendopo batu dengan lantai berukiran kuno, pilar kayu jati berukir, atap ijuk tinggi, obor api memberi cahaya dramatis, singgasana kayu berukir di tengah

props.physical_characteristics: Kantung goni cokelat kasar diikat leher dengan tali hemp fray, noda lumpur, beberapa butir beras putih menyembul di sambungan
Tombak infantri: batang kayu jati gelap 8 kaki, mata tombak perunggu daun memanjang dengan bevel tajam, kerah kawat kuningan dan jumbai rambut kuda merah

visual.prompt: Cinematic realistic extreme wide tracking shot, young Javanese man Ken Arok sprints through dense tropical teak forest at midday, holding rough jute rice sack against chest, bare feet kicking up dust, three armored Tumapel soldiers chase in distant background with raised spears. Golden god rays cut through canopy, depth of field, motion blur on foliage, 50mm lens, 16:9 horizontal

motion.camera: rapid backward tracking, ahead of subject
motion.prompt: Camera tracks rapidly backward ahead of Ken Arok, keeping him centered as foliage whips past frame edges

audio.bgm: tense tribal percussion building, fast tempo matching footstep rhythm
audio.sfx: heavy panting, twigs snapping, distant shouting soldiers, metallic armor rattle

visual.prompt: Cinematic realistic medium low-angle shot, Ken Arok lands on mossy fallen log, pivots to face camera with arrogant grin, one hand grips jute rice sack, other gestures dismissively. Three soldiers in background with spears leveled, panting. Forest midday sun, dappled shadows, 35mm lens, 16:9 horizontal

motion.camera: low-angle medium, slight pan up as subject lands
motion.prompt: Low-angle medium shot pans slightly up as Ken Arok lands on log, emphasizing agile stance and height advantage over pursuers

audio.tts_text: Hanya segitu kecepatan prajurit istana? Kura-kura di rawa pun masih bisa mendahului kalian!
audio.sfx: subject's confident exhale, soldiers' guttural grunts

visual.prompt: Cinematic realistic medium shot, old Brahmin sage Dang Hyang Lohgawe emerges calmly from behind massive banyan tree, weathered white robes glowing in dappled sunlight, right hand raised in peaceful commanding gesture. Soldiers in background lowering weapons in awe. Forest midday, ethereal soft light, 50mm lens, 16:9 horizontal

motion.camera: slow stately tilt up from hem of robes to serene face and raised hand
motion.prompt: Slow tilt-up from hem of Lohgawe's robes revealing his serene face and raised hand, establishing dominant spiritual presence

audio.tts_text: Hentikan amarah kalian. Darah anak muda ini bukan untuk tumpah di tanah berlumpur ini.
audio.bgm: ambient drone fades in, percussion silences
audio.sfx: wind hushes through leaves, soldiers' footsteps stop

segments.notes: Pivot moment — sage halts conflict, shifts tone

visual.prompt: Cinematic realistic slow two-shot arc, Dang Hyang Lohgawe stands close to Ken Arok, piercing eyes into young rebel's soul. Ken Arok paralyzed in disbelief, defiant posture softening. Soft warm sunlight between two men, ancient forest canopy behind. Slow arc around them, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, 16:9 horizontal

motion.camera: slow tense two-shot arc, rotates around the two men
motion.prompt: Slow tense two-shot arc gently rotates around the two men, ending framed over Lohgawe's shoulder onto Ken Arok's stunned reaction

audio.tts_text: Aku tidak menaruh kasihan, Ken Arok. Aku menaruh ramalan. Dewa Wisnu tidak mengirimmu ke dunia fana hanya untuk menjadi pencuri rendahan.
audio.bgm: low ethereal drone swells, all other ambient cut
audio.sfx: subject's breath catches, heartbeat subtly thumps

segments.notes: The prophecy moment — turning point of Ken Arok's life

visual.prompt: Cinematic realistic extreme close-up on Ken Arok's eyes, wide and astonished, reflecting golden light. Jaw clenched, breath caught. Background forest dissolves into shallow dreamlike blur. Snap zoom punch-in effect, 85mm lens, 16:9 horizontal

motion.camera: rapid snap zoom punch-in to pupils, freeze, then subtle handheld tremble
motion.prompt: Rapid snap zoom punch-in directly into Ken Arok's pupils, freezing momentarily before settling with subtle trembling handheld framing

audio.bgm: heartbeat thump loud, sub-bass pulse, ethereal chime
audio.sfx: muffled heartbeat, subtle whoosh mirroring thunderous shock
